name: use-case-features
title: Use case features
description: Use-case feature cards, comparison tables, before-and-after panels, and the API example section.
usage: The middle of a use case page, inside a `SiteSection` under a `SectionHeading` and `SectionHeaderRule`. Cards three across when they divide by three, two otherwise, or `layout="rows"` with each story beside its text. One highlighted column in a comparison (its header in blue on white, its cells on a faint blue wash). `UseCaseApiExample` is a section of its own (no SiteSection around it) for one endpoint's request and response beside the playground and API reference pills.
avoid: Colored icon tiles other than brand blue
Tables that squeeze their columns on phones (they scroll)
A tinted header cell on the highlighted column

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
